thesis: A clean match is an interruptible six-phase protocol that earns deeper disclosure and human attention.
role: Describe discovery, qualification, evidence and negotiation.

ideas.statement: Private intent, discovery, reciprocal qualification, evidence exchange, constraint negotiation and handoff reduce uncertainty in stages, with refusal a valid outcome.
Question provenance and proportional reciprocal access prevent qualification becoming extraction; relevant evidence and paid proportionate trials test claims.
Negotiation distinguishes preference, provisional alignment and binding authority, then hands humans a concise verified-and-unresolved brief.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Advanced cryptography is optional for concrete threats; initial privacy comes largely from minimization and policy.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
